report: Requirements reassessed: unknown work must remain visible; supported Sage/metadata operations have stable operation families; queries lacking semantic projection retain unmapped/raw diagnostic ingredients; unexpected fallback must fail a checked closed dependency claim. The sole ordinary implementation association is build_dynamic_trace in src/inspector.rs. QueryEnter and QueryLeaf preserve their entire key as TraceKey::Unmapped and derive the operation prefix with query_operation; ExternalMetadata similarly preserves its raw operation while extracting the family before the first parenthesis. Semantic phase/span operations retain their producer-supplied names. attach_trace_node inserts nodes under their parent or into roots without filtering; normalization sorts rather than removes nodes, unmatched exits add unmapped recorder-error nodes, and remaining open nodes are drained into the tree. These paths support consumer retention, including unknown families and keys without parentheses, but do not independently establish producer completeness or closed-claim enforcement. The complete associated test set is the single TODO service_spec function crates_sage_inspector_inspection_unknown_work: it has no assertions and explicitly defers complete evidence for balanced Salsa requests, metadata calls, and forbidden-demand checks that cannot filter unknown nodes. Its prerequisite is complete associated/reviewed real-trace evidence and a checked closed-dependency/forbidden-demand test path that exercises unexpected fallback; stable-family/retention behavior also needs actual assertions in that evidence. This is an accepted explicit coverage deferral, not a claim that enforcement or full end-to-end behavior is implemented. Independently inspected the current claim, association metadata, test body, trace builder and same-file helpers; verified both legacy implementation and test-source snapshots exactly match current files. Historical approval was not treated as behavioral execution. Ran review start/read and byte comparisons only; no behavioral tests or build were run by this reviewer. Coordinator-reported passing suite/build are separate execution evidence. No source edits or additional implementation dependencies were used. No changes to the existing explicit TODO accounting are required.
